decisions.csharp: Canonical SourceText receiver uses the concrete byte-owner path before a known-empty payload loan. Text receivers retain upstream span origins.
decisions.slgBefore: Generic slice opcode -203 queries the payload fact first and falls back to a concrete place only when unavailable; SourceText canonical type is not selected first.
decisions.required: Select the materialized SourceText type before generic slice origin lookup; preserve the ordinary Text branch.

decisions.csharp: Call-site mapping unwraps readonly references before classifying SourceText/Arena concrete storage parameters.
decisions.slgBefore: Concrete parameter contracts use raw typeOrigin/typeSymbol for SourceText/Arena rather than their materialized type. Byte-array canonical checks are already shared.
decisions.required: Use the committed materialized formal type for source storage and preserve existing byte-array and whole-owner transfer rules.

decisions.csharp: An owned SourceText field retains its exact field place even when the parent carries an unrelated external Text loan.
decisions.slgBefore: Independent field classification explicitly excludes SourceText symbol24, so concrete field lookup may recover the parent payload origin instead.
decisions.required: Admit the committed owning SourceText field as independent storage; retain reference fields and ordinary Text on their existing loan paths.

decisions.csharp: Shared BorrowedTextReturnPolicy.RequiresOriginCheck rejects local byte owners and moved owners; live external and readonly inputs remain allowed.
decisions.slgBefore: The same compiled Boolean policy is already consumed by the local escape scan.
decisions.required: Retain the shared decision and diagnostics; correct source-origin facts only.

externalTextSiblingComparison.decision: CSharp concrete-place lookup first preserves any nonempty active upstream loan, including a formal external Text parameter. SLG must query parameter loans while discovering that upstream fact even when the caller is testing a local storage origin. Keep the queried origin identity and owned-storage fallback unchanged.
